dispute_ticket.description: I was billed S$150 for a mud stain I never made. I came from home in sandals, nothing was dirty. Please refund the full amount.

chat_logs.content: Waiting at the taxi stand, black Serena.

app_events.details: Rider R-5410 booked trip RYDE-PS-003 from Buona Vista MRT to VivoCity.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$150.00 with 1 photo.
S$150.00 cleaning fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_tiers.value: food or drink spill up to S$40; stains (mud, dirt) and bodily fluids up to S$120; vomit up to S$200
cleaning_fee_tiers.text: Usual fee by type of mess; a fee above the tier for the mess type needs a receipt.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photo of the mess and a cleaning receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt, a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Mud on the middle-row floor after the passenger left VivoCity.

expected_outcome.reason: The photo's capture time is 07:41, which is 94 min before the rider was picked up at 09:15 and 116 min before the 09:37 drop-off, so it cannot show a mess left by this trip; it was uploaded at 09:58 with the caption 'after the passenger left'. The rider denies any mess. The driver also has no receipt and S$150 is above the S$120 stain tier. Both weaknesses point to removal, but under this trip's photo-doubt rule the timing of the photo is in doubt, so a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically (no automatic refund).
